outcome: prevalence of clinically significant red cell alloantibodies
cohort: The study included 6135 pregnant women who underwent pretransfusion testing at a hospital in Malaysia between 2020 and 2021.
finding: The prevalence of clinically significant red cell alloantibodies was 0.8%, with anti-Mia being the most common, and no significant association was found between maternal age and these alloantibodies.
